author: freehunter.hk
title: Freelance calendar illustration job
content: Freelance illustration work: annual desk calendar illustrations (12 pieces). Budget: HKD$10,000-$50,000. Company background: social service organization, needs 2026 desk calendar illustrations for promotion and use. Scope: 12 calendar illustrations; each output in 2 sizes; each paired with 12 corresponding text lines. Interested parties: follow the account then comment Job to receive job details.
